writingTools.pageSubtitle: A suite of powerful AI tools to enhance your writing and research.

imageToPdf.pageSubtitle: Combine multiple images into a single PDF file with ease.
imageToPdf.cardDescription: Upload, reorder, and convert your images into a PDF document.
imageToPdf.dropzoneTitle: Drag 'n' drop some files here, or click to select files
imageToPdf.dropzoneSubtitle: Upload one or more images (JPG, PNG, GIF, WEBP)
imageToPdf.toastFilesAddedDesc: {count} images have been added to the queue.
imageToPdf.toastNoImagesDesc: Please upload at least one image to generate a PDF.
imageToPdf.toastGeneratingDesc: Your PDF is being created and will be downloaded shortly.
imageToPdf.toastSuccessDesc: Your PDF has been successfully created and downloaded.

ideaGenerator.pageSubtitle: Brainstorm unique ideas based on your specialization and context.
ideaGenerator.cardDescription: Provide your context and let our AI brainstorm innovative ideas for you.
ideaGenerator.specializationPlaceholder: e.g., Full-Stack Web Development, Digital Marketing
ideaGenerator.additionalContextPlaceholder: Provide any other details, like target audience, budget constraints, etc.

textStylist.pageSubtitle: Refine your writing by rewriting text in various styles or summarizing it to a specific length.
textStylist.aiToolsDescription: Use the tools below to refine your text.
textStylist.comparisonDescription: View your original text and the AI-processed version.
textStylist.originalTextPlaceholder: Your original text will appear here once you process it.
textStylist.processedTextPlaceholder: Your processed text will appear here...
textStylist.toastStyleRequiredDesc: Please select a style to rewrite the text.

documentWriter.pageSubtitle: Generate complete documents, essays, or reports from a single topic.
documentWriter.cardDescription: Provide a topic and let the AI generate a complete document for you.
documentWriter.topicPlaceholder: e.g., The Future of Renewable Energy
documentWriter.knowledgePlaceholder: e.g., Keep the tone formal and include a section on challenges.
documentWriter.tocPlaceholder: Enter one heading per line to define the document structure.

presentationOutline.pageSubtitle: Generate a structured outline for your presentation from a single topic.
presentationOutline.cardDescription: Provide a topic, and the AI will generate a structured outline for your presentation.
presentationOutline.topicPlaceholder: e.g., The Future of Artificial Intelligence
presentationOutline.documentationPlaceholder: Paste any relevant context, articles, or notes here to guide the outline generation...

plagiarismChecker.pageSubtitle: Check your text for potential plagiarism against online sources.
plagiarismChecker.cardDescription: Enter your text below to check it for potential plagiarism and ensure its originality.
plagiarismChecker.placeholder: Paste your article, essay, or any text here...
plagiarismChecker.dropzoneHint: Drag 'n' drop a file here, or click to select
plagiarismChecker.analyzing: Analyzing claims and searching for sources...
plagiarismChecker.originalityScoreDesc: This score represents the percentage of your text that is unique.
plagiarismChecker.matchesDescription: We found potential matches from the following sources. Review them to ensure proper citation.
plagiarismChecker.noMatches: No direct matches found. The content appears to be original.
plagiarismChecker.authErrorDesc: You must be logged in to process files.

humanizer.pageSubtitle: Make AI-generated text sound more natural and less robotic.
humanizer.cardDescription: Paste your AI-generated text below, and the tool will rewrite it to have a more human-like tone and style.

aiDetector.pageSubtitle: Analyze text to determine the likelihood that it was written by AI.
aiDetector.cardDescription: Paste your text or upload a file. Our AI will analyze it and provide a probability score of it being AI-generated.
aiDetector.placeholder: Enter text to analyze for AI generation...
aiDetector.dropzoneHint: Drag 'n' drop a file here, or click to select a file
aiDetector.toastFileExtracted: Text extracted from {fileName}. You can now start the analysis.

paraphraser.pageSubtitle: Rewrite your text in different styles to enhance clarity, fluency, or creativity.
paraphraser.cardDescription: Enter the text you want to rewrite, select a mode, and let the AI do the rest.
paraphraser.dropzoneHint: Drag 'n' drop a file here, or click to select a file
paraphraser.toastAuthErrorDesc: You must be logged in to process files.

summarizer.pageSubtitle: Condense long texts into concise summaries of your desired length.
summarizer.cardDescription: Enter the text you want to summarize, select the desired length, and let the AI do the work.
summarizer.placeholder: Paste your long article, report, or any text here...
summarizer.dropzoneHint: Drag 'n' drop a file here, or click to select

grammarChecker.pageSubtitle: Correct spelling and grammar mistakes in your text instantly.
grammarChecker.cardDescription: Enter the text you want to check, and the AI will correct any mistakes and explain the changes.
grammarChecker.dropzoneHint: Drag 'n' drop a file here, or click to select a file

aiQuizGenerator.pageSubtitle: Turn any text into an engaging quiz with just a few clicks.
aiQuizGenerator.cardDescription: Enter text and the AI will create a multiple-choice quiz based on the content.
aiQuizGenerator.placeholder: Paste the article, notes, or any text you want to create a quiz from...

factChecker.pageSubtitle: Verify factual claims within your text against web sources.
factChecker.cardDescription: Enter text containing claims, and the AI will attempt to verify them against reliable sources.
factChecker.placeholder: e.g., The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889 and is located in Paris, France.
factChecker.dropzoneHint: Drag 'n' drop a file here, or click to select
factChecker.analyzing: Analyzing claims and searching for sources...
factChecker.originalityScoreDesc: This score represents the factual accuracy of the text.
factChecker.matchesDescription: The AI has identified and verified the following claims from your text.
factChecker.noClaims: No verifiable claims were found in the provided text.

citationGenerator.pageSubtitle: Generate accurate citations in APA, MLA, Chicago, and more styles from any source.
citationGenerator.cardDescription: Enter a URL, book title, or any source material, and the AI will generate the citation for you.
citationGenerator.placeholder: e.g., https://www.example.com/article or 'The Great Gatsby by F. Scott Fitzgerald'

aiResearcher.pageSubtitle: Your AI-powered assistant to research any topic.
aiResearcher.cardDescription: Enter a topic, and the AI will conduct research and provide a structured report.
aiResearcher.topicPlaceholder: e.g., The impact of quantum computing on cryptography
aiResearcher.researching: Researching... This may take a moment as the AI browses and synthesizes information.
aiResearcher.addToProjectDesc: Select a project to add this research report as a context file.
aiResearcher.toastContextAddedDesc: Research on "{researchTitle}" has been added to the project.

topicExplainer.pageSubtitle: Break down any complex topic into a simple, easy-to-understand explanation.
topicExplainer.cardDescription: Enter a topic, and the AI will provide a simple and clear explanation.

handwriting.pageSubtitle: Convert your typed text into a realistic handwriting style.
handwriting.outputDescription: The generated handwriting will appear here. Click Redraw for a new variation.
handwriting.controlsDescription: Adjust the settings for your text.

assignmentsSolver.pageSubtitle: Upload assignments or paste text to get comprehensive solutions powered by AI.
assignmentsSolver.cardDescription: Upload PDF assignments or paste text containing questions, and get detailed solutions in markdown format.
assignmentsSolver.placeholder:
Paste your assignment questions here...

Example:
1. What is photosynthesis and why is it important?
2. Explain the water cycle in detail.
3. Calculate the area of a triangle with base 10cm and height 8cm.
assignmentsSolver.dropzoneHint: Drag 'n' drop an assignment file here, or click to select
assignmentsSolver.supportedFiles: Supported: PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT, MD
assignmentsSolver.processingMessage: Analyzing questions and generating comprehensive solutions...

projectBlueprint.pageSubtitle: Generate comprehensive layered project blueprints with enterprise-grade architecture patterns and implementation guidelines.
projectBlueprint.cardDescription: Create detailed project blueprints including architecture, features, timeline, and implementation strategy.
projectBlueprint.projectNamePlaceholder: Enter your project name (e.g., E-learning Platform)
projectBlueprint.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe your project vision, goals, and main purpose in detail...
projectBlueprint.targetAudiencePlaceholder: Who will use this application? Describe your target users, their needs, and demographics...
projectBlueprint.featuresPlaceholder:
List the main features and functionalities you want to include:
• User authentication
• Dashboard
• Payment system
• Real-time notifications
• Mobile responsiveness
• etc.
projectBlueprint.techStackPlaceholder: Specify preferred technologies, frameworks, or platforms (e.g., React, Node.js, PostgreSQL)...
projectBlueprint.processingMessage: Analyzing requirements and generating comprehensive project blueprint...
projectBlueprint.emptyState: Your project blueprint will appear here after generation

uiDescription.pageSubtitle: Transform project features into a detailed UI/UX workflow description.
uiDescription.cardDescription: Describe your project's features, and the AI will generate a screen-by-screen UI workflow.
uiDescription.featuresPlaceholder:
List your project's core features using markdown...
- User registration and login
- Dashboard to view statistics
- Profile editing page
uiDescription.processingMessage: Analyzing features and designing UI workflow...
